title: KATSEYE
description: Test your knowledge of the HYBE x Geffen global girl group!

questions.question: Which two record labels co-created KATSEYE?
questions.explanation: KATSEYE was formed through a partnership between HYBE and Geffen Records.

questions.question: What reality competition show formed KATSEYE?
questions.explanation: The group debuted via 'The Debut: Dream Academy', a global audition show by HYBE x Geffen.

questions.question: KATSEYE has six members.
questions.explanation: Final lineup has 6 members: Lara, Daniela, Megan, Manon, Sophia, and Yoonchae.

questions.question: Which member is the youngest in KATSEYE?
questions.explanation: Yoonchae, born in 2007, is the maknae (youngest member) of KATSEYE.

questions.question: What was KATSEYE's debut single?
questions.explanation: 'Debut' was their official debut single, released in June 2024.

questions.question: KATSEYE's members come from multiple countries, making it a global group.
questions.explanation: Members hail from the U.S., South Korea, Switzerland, the Philippines, India, and more, by design.

questions.question: What is the title of KATSEYE's debut EP?
questions.explanation: Their debut mini-album 'SIS (Soft Is Strong)' was released in 2024.

questions.question: Which member is from Switzerland?
questions.explanation: Manon Bannerman is Swiss-Ghanaian, originally from Switzerland.

questions.question: Which 2025 KATSEYE song went viral on TikTok?
questions.explanation: 'Gnarly' became a viral TikTok hit thanks to its hooky chorus and dance.

questions.question: KATSEYE is based in Los Angeles rather than Seoul.
questions.explanation: Unlike most HYBE groups, KATSEYE trains and operates primarily from Los Angeles.

questions.question: Which member is from the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Sophia Laforteza is Filipino, born in Manila.

questions.question: KATSEYE's fandom is officially named EYEKONS.
questions.explanation: KATSEYE's fandom is named 'EYEKONZ' — though spelling has varied in marketing.
